title: Projektetage Vite Spec Import
description: Fix Vite dev failing to resolve @semio-tech/mit-bestand-praesentation-projektetage-spec when loading framework presentation renderer from 33.projektetage.
summary: Vite dev/build for 33.projektetage failed because the presentation renderer’s vitest-only dynamic imports reference `@semio-tech/mit-bestand-praesentation-projektetage-spec`, which was aliased in vitest.config.ts but not in the app’s vite.config.ts. Added the same resolve alias pointing at `spec.ts` in `mit-bestand/präsentation/33.projektetage/vite.config.ts`. Verified with `bun nx run @semio-tech/mit-bestand-praesentation-projektetage:build --skip-nx-cache` (exit 0).
